scope: 6 screens x PT/EN x 390x560 and 1440x900 x five scroll positions; shared header text2x and mobile resize
limitations: Canvas/Plotly internals and cross-origin iframe text require separate functional tests.
Background hero images and foreground title overlays are intentional and excluded from image collisions.
Partly clipped lines at scroll-viewport edges and CSS-hidden accessibility labels are excluded.
Text2x doubles computed font-size/line-height as a deterministic reflow stress test; it is not native browser zoom.
